name: com.nofussblueprint/rough-math
title: Money Gotchas Rough Math
description: Rough money calculators: quiet subscriptions, pay-in-4, work hours, card payoff, net worth.

tools.name: safe_to_spend
tools.description: Rough safe-to-spend number: takes the bank balance shown in the app and subtracts bills due before the next payday, card charges not yet paid off, and money already set aside. Use when someone asks how much they can actually spend until payday. Balance may be negative (overdrawn).

balance.description: Balance the bank app shows, in US dollars. Negative if overdrawn.

bills_before_payday.description: Bills due before the next payday (rent, phone, insurance).

card_charges.description: Card charges not paid off yet.

set_aside.description: Money already set aside for something.

tools.name: subscription_cost
tools.description: Adds up monthly subscription charges and shows the monthly, daily and yearly total. Yearly plans should be divided by 12 first.

monthly_charges.description: Each subscription's monthly price in US dollars.

tools.name: pay_later_share
tools.description: Buy now, pay later check: adds the pay-in-4 installments the next paycheck has to cover (due after it lands and before the one after it) and shows the share of the paycheck already promised, before rent and groceries.

next_paycheck.description: Next paycheck after tax, in US dollars.

installments.description: Each installment that paycheck has to cover.

tools.name: credit_card_payoff
tools.description: Credit card payoff at a fixed monthly payment: months to reach zero and total interest, plus the same with $50 more a month. Assumes the same payment and APR every month and no new purchases or fees; real minimums shrink, so paying only the minimum takes longer.

tools.name: net_worth
tools.description: Rough net worth: what you own minus what you owe. Count things at what they'd sell for today; skip things you'd never sell.

own.description: Values of what you own: savings, retirement, car at resale price, home, anything else worth selling.

owe.description: What you owe: cards, student loans, car loan, mortgage, other loans.

tools.name: work_hours_cost
tools.description: Turns a regular expense into hours and workdays of take-home pay per year. Uses 173 working hours a month and 8-hour workdays.

monthly_take_home.description: Take-home pay per month, in US dollars.
